avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May reduce hydroxyzine levels via CYP3A4 induction; decreased anxiolytic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced effectiveness; consult prescriber before combining

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; increased sedation and impairment

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; excessive sedation, dizziness, and impaired cognition
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision with dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild additive CNS depressant effects; may increase drowsiness
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation

caution_supplements.name: Chamomile
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild additive sedative effects; minimal interaction risk
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe; advise patient to monitor for increased drowsiness

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; may enhance sedation
caution_supplements.action: Use together cautiously; monitor sleep quality and daytime function

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Marked additive CNS depression; significantly impairs cognition, coordination, and reaction time
caution_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance or strict limitation; warn against driving/operating machinery

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase hydroxyzine levels and side effects
caution_foods.action: Avoid or limit intake; monitor for enhanced sedation and anticholinergic effects

monitoring_notes: Hydroxyzine has significant CNS depressant effects; monitor for excessive sedation, anticholinergic symptoms (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation), and impaired cognition. Counsel on avoiding alcohol and other depressants; caution regarding driving and hazardous activities, especially with concurrent supplements or foods affecting CYP3A4/2D6.
